title: Malicious code in danz-bails (npm)
description: The danz-bails npm package, a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web library, contains malicious code that covertly uses the installer's authenticated WhatsApp session to subscribe the account to specific WhatsApp Channels without user consent. This behavior occurs automatically when a WhatsApp socket is created and cannot be disabled for three hidden channels. The package does not exfiltrate credentials or maintain persistence but abuses the victim's account to inflate channel subscriber counts. Versions 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 are affected.
